leadText: Zeno Robinson is an American actor for the English-language dub of and .
plainText:
Zeno Robinson is an American actor for the English-language dub of and .

==Biography==
Robinson was born on October 25, 1993. As a teenager, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Robinson joined the during , where he voiced one of the main characters, Goh.
